translationRepairs: Huilin changed his name to Huiquan.
s0039 is 惠林更名惠全; 更名 means changed his name. The before field leaves that clause untranslated; the proposed idiomatic correctly renders the renaming.
Huilin changed his name to Huiquan.
The literal likewise leaves 更名 untranslated, so a repair is needed; but the proposed “changed name” is ungrammatical. Render 更名 as “changed his name,” matching the Chinese renaming statement.

On the gengshen day of the fourth month, 張澐卿 was transferred. On the gengxu day of the sixth month, 賀壽慈: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. On the jiwei day, 劾 was removed from office. On the renyin day of the eighth month, 陳蘭彬: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. 未任. On the bingwu day, 夏家鎬 served in an acting capacity.

On the gengshen day of the fourth month, Zhang Yunqing was transferred. On the gengxu day of the sixth month, He Shouci: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. On the jiwei day, he was removed from office upon impeachment. On the renyin day of the eighth month, Chen Lanbin: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. He did not assume the post. On the bingwu day, Xia Jiagao served in an acting capacity.

s0085 has 己未劾免 after 賀壽慈’s appointment: 劾免 is removal upon impeachment, not a person 劾; 未任 after 陳蘭彬 means he did not assume the post. The proposed idiomatic fixes both errors and correctly attributes the actions.
陳蘭彬夏家鎬仍 served in an acting capacity.
Chen Lanbin; Xia Jiagao continued to serve in an acting capacity.

s0096 陳蘭彬夏家鎬仍署 lists two officials with 仍署: Chen as the continuing holder and Xia continuing to act. The before fuses the names into broken English; the proposed semicolon wording matches the Chinese.

On the guisi day of the fifth month, 程祖誥 retired. On the xinwei day of the seventh month, 曾紀澤: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. 未任. 徐用儀 served in an acting capacity. On the guiwei day of the twelfth month, 改 served in an acting capacity. 張家驤 served in an acting capacity as Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.

On the guisi day of the fifth month, Cheng Zugao retired. On the xinwei day of the seventh month, Zeng Jize: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. He did not assume the post. Xu Yongyi served in an acting capacity. On the guiwei day of the twelfth month, the acting appointment was changed. Zhang Jiaxiang served in an acting capacity as Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
s0105 has 未任 after 曾紀澤 and later 十二月癸未改署, where 改署 means the acting appointment was changed, not a person named 改. The proposed idiomatic corrects both misreadings.

On the yisi day of the fourth month, 陳蘭彬夏家鎬 was transferred. On the jiyou day, 許庚身 served in an acting capacity as Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. In the twelfth month, the officeholder was transferred. 周家楣 served in an acting capacity.

On the yisi day of the fourth month, Chen Lanbin and Xia Jiagao were transferred. On the jiyou day, Xu Gengshen served in an acting capacity as Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. In the twelfth month, he was transferred. Zhou Jiamei served in an acting capacity.
s0106 opens 陳蘭彬夏家鎬四月乙巳遷: two persons transferred, not one fused name. 十二月遷 then refers to the acting appointee 許庚身. The proposed split and “he was transferred” match the Chinese sequence.

On the bingxu day of the fourth month, 曾紀澤張家驤 was transferred. 王之翰 served in an acting capacity as Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. On the guisi day of the eleventh month, retired. 張佩綸 served in an acting capacity.

On the bingxu day of the fourth month, Zeng Jize and Zhang Jiaxiang were transferred. Wang Zhihan served in an acting capacity as Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. On the guisi day of the eleventh month, he retired. Zhang Peilun served in an acting capacity.
s0116 曾紀澤張家驤四月丙戌遷 are two men transferred; 十一月癸巳休致 follows 王之翰署 and marks Wang’s retirement. The proposal unfuses the names and supplies the retirement subject correctly.
曾紀澤張佩綸仍 served in an acting capacity.
Zeng Jize; Zhang Peilun continued to serve in an acting capacity.
s0127 曾紀澤張佩綸仍署 parallels other dual-name 仍署 cells: Zeng continues as holder and Zhang Peilun continues acting. The proposed wording repairs the fused broken English.
吳大澂沈源深仍 served in an acting capacity.
Wu Dacheng; Shen Yuanshen continued to serve in an acting capacity.
s0148 吳大澂沈源深仍署 likewise names Wu as continuing holder and Shen as continuing actor. The proposed idiomatic restores that reading from the garbled before text.

On the gengchen day of the sixth month, 白桓 was sent on assignment. 胡瑞瀾 served in an acting capacity as Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. In the eighth month, was sent on assignment. On the jisi day, 周家楣 served in an acting capacity. On the bingshen day of the eleventh month, 改 served in an acting capacity. On the wushen day, 徐樹銘 served in an acting capacity as Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.

On the gengchen day of the sixth month, Bai Huan was sent on assignment. Hu Ruilan served in an acting capacity as Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. In the eighth month, he was sent on assignment. On the jisi day, Zhou Jiamei served in an acting capacity. On the bingshen day of the eleventh month, the acting appointment was changed. On the wushen day, Xu Shuming served in an acting capacity as Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
s0149 has 十一月丙申改署 then 戊申徐樹銘署: 改署 is changing the acting appointment, not a person 改. The proposal also supplies the missing subject for 八月差 (Hu Ruilan).

On the jiachen day of the second month, 白桓 was transferred. On the guiyou day of the third month, 沈源深: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. On the renyin day of the eighth month, 差. 錢應溥 served in an acting capacity as Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. On the dingwei day of the eleventh month, was transferred. 黃體芳 served in an acting capacity as Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.

On the jiachen day of the second month, Bai Huan was transferred. On the guiyou day of the third month, Shen Yuanshen: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. On the renyin day of the eighth month, he was sent on assignment. Qian Yingpu served in an acting capacity as Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. On the dingwei day of the eleventh month, he was transferred. Huang Tifang served in an acting capacity as Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
s0192 八月壬寅差 after 沈源深’s appointment means he was sent on assignment; 十一月丁未遷 then refers to acting 錢應溥. Leaving bare 差 is incomplete; the proposed subjects match the Chinese sequence.
薛福成壽昌仍 served in an acting capacity.
Xue Fucheng; Shouchang continued to serve in an acting capacity.

s0234 薛福成壽昌仍署 does name two men with 仍署, so the fused before text is wrong; but “For Xue Fucheng’s post” invents an unfilled-post gloss not stated in this cell. Use the same dual-name 仍署 pattern as elsewhere: Xue as holder, Shouchang continuing to act.
薛福成壽昌仍 served in an acting capacity.
Xue Fucheng: Shouchang still served in an acting capacity.
The literal must also separate 薛福成 from 壽昌 under 仍署. “Xue Fucheng: Shouchang still served in an acting capacity” correctly distinguishes the appointee from the continuing acting official.

On the renxu day of the fifth month, 楊頤 was transferred. 楊儒: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. 未任. 馮文蔚 served in an acting capacity as Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. In the twelfth month, died. On the renxu day, 陸寶忠 served in an acting capacity.

On the renxu day of the fifth month, Yang Yi was transferred. Yang Ru: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief; he did not assume the office. Feng Wenwei served in an acting capacity as Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. In the twelfth month, Feng Wenwei died. On the renxu day, Lu Baozhong served in an acting capacity.
s0265 楊儒……未任 means Yang Ru did not assume office; 馮文蔚署……十二月卒 makes Feng the subject of the twelfth-month death. The proposed idiomatic supplies both missing readings without inventing other actors.

On the dingmao day of the eighth month, 裕德 was transferred. 懷塔布: Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs. On the wuxu day of the twelfth month, died. On the xinchou day, 世續: Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs. On the bingyin day of the twelfth month, was transferred. 阿克丹: Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

On the dingmao day of the eighth month, Yude was transferred. Huaitabu: Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs. On the wuxu day of the twelfth month, Huaitabu died. On the xinchou day, Shixu: Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs. On the bingyin day of the twelfth month, Shixu was transferred. Akedan: Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
s0301 sequence 懷塔布理藩院尚書。十二月戊戌卒 then 世續……十二月丙寅遷 assigns the death to Huaitabu and the later transfer to Shixu. The proposed subjects restore that narrative linkage.
